# `array_min`

<!-- @generated by `cargo xtask docs-sql`; do not edit. -->

```text
array_min(array)
```

Returns the minimum value in the array. NaN is greater than
any non-NaN elements for double/float type. NULL elements are skipped.

| | |
|---|---|
| Krishiv | Implemented |
| Group | `array_funcs` |
| Kind | scalar (function) |
| Added in Spark | 2.4.0 |
| In Spark profiles | 3.5 and later |
| Arguments | 1 |
| Deterministic | yes |

## Examples

```sql
-- array_min, example 1
> SELECT array_min(array(1, 20, null, 3));
1
```
